verdict.rationale: Apify is a data-gathering platform that integrates with AI agents through its MCP server, so asking whether it offers an agent reasoning-effort control is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains no low, medium, or high reasoning-effort setting for any autonomous agent. Actor input parameters such as maxCrawlPages are crawl limits, which is an adjacent feature and not reasoning-effort control.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
